API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIZDX SnapshotsShare a ZDX Snapshot of alert details for a given alert ID
Share a ZDX Snapshot of alert details for a given alert ID
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/snapshot/alert

Share a ZDX Snapshot of alert details for a given alert ID.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODYREQUIRED
name
string
REQUIRED

The name of the ZDX Snapshot.

alert_id
string
REQUIRED

The alert ID to create a ZDX Snapshot for.

expiry
integer

The expiration time in Unix Epoch (seconds). The default is set to 2 hours. To configure, the expiration must be between 2 hours and 90 days.

obfuscation
string[]

Specifies the fields to obfuscate in ZDX snapshot. The possible values are: "USER_NAME", "LOCATION", "DEVICE_NAME", "IP_ADDRESS", "WIFI_NAME"

Possible values: [USER_NAME, LOCATION, DEVICE_NAME, IP_ADDRESS, WIFI_NAME]

Responses
​
200
400
401
403

Successful Operation. The response contains ID, name, URL, expiration, and status of the ZDX Snapshot created.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
integer

The ZDX Snapshot ID.

name
string

The name of the ZDX Snapshot.

url
string

The URL to access the created ZDX Snapshot.

expiry
integer

The expiration time in seconds.

status
string

The status of the ZDX Snapshot.
